name: Te Moata Retreat Centre
tradition: Insight Meditation (Western Vipassana teacher lineage, non-Goenka), hosted on non-sectarian land
teacherAccess: Daily talks and interviews typical of Insight Meditation retreats
about: A 344-hectare land trust on the Coromandel Peninsula that hosts many unrelated retreat groups; its own annual Insight Meditation retreat, led by a teacher trained under Joseph Goldstein and Gil Fronsdal, is genuinely meditation-central and residential even though the land itself is non-sectarian and multi-use.
